_comment: Standard 3-guesser pool (see configs/guesser_pool.json), each entry wrapped in HistoryAwareGuesser (codenames/guessers/history_aware.py) instead of left plain -- noise_std fixed at 0.08 (matching cache/m9/pool_configs/noise_0_08.json, the pool learned:noise_0_08 was actually trained/evaluated against, not guesser_pool.json's own default of 0.03) so an arena run against this config is directly comparable to one against noise_0_08.json: same three guessers, same weights/seeds, the only difference is whether each guesser can claim the earned bonus guess described in codenames/guessers/base.py's module docstring.
